bills.title: The Municipal Sidewalk & Streetlamp Repair Act
bills.summary: Funds cracked sidewalk repairs, crosswalk repainting, and new LED streetlamps across rural towns and school bus routes.

rider.text: Section 14: Reclassifies the Appropriations Chairman's private country-club driveway as a 'Critical Federal Highway' eligible for $18,000,000 in heated cobblestones.

heckles.text: Clean AYE, rookie. Show Leadership you're a team player.
Wait a second—what's paper-clipped to the edge of that bill?

aye.headline: HEATED DRIVEWAY FIASCO! BARKER APPROVES $18M COUNTRY-CLUB COBBLESTONES!
aye.subhead: Maple Creek gets two new lamp bulbs while Capitol insiders toast their snow-melting asphalt.

nay.headline: ROOKIE REP PEELS BACK $18M DRIVEWAY RIDER; WHIP FANG FUMES!
nay.subhead: Voters cheer Barker's eagle eyes—though rival press releases already claim he 'opposes streetlamps.'

abstain.headline: BARKER SITS OUT STREETLAMP VOTE: 'I NEEDED MORE TIME TO PONDER SIDEWALKS'
abstain.subhead: Neither Maple Creek commuters nor the Caucus Whip look impressed.

bills.title: The Clean River & Public Footbridge Act
bills.summary: Protects municipal drinking wells from industrial runoff and replaces the aging timber footbridge linking Main Street to the west bank.

heckles.text: Vote NAY quietly, Barker. My toll-ferry client rewards loyalty.
Zero tricks in this text—just clean water and a safe bridge!

aye.headline: BARKER SAVES RIVER BRIDGE; PRIVATE TOLL-FERRY LOBBY SENT PACKING!
aye.subhead: Sal Viper hands out free celebratory sourdough on Main Street while Vesper Viper cancels a donor gala.

nay.headline: COMMUTERS STRANDED! BARKER KILLS FREE BRIDGE HOURS AFTER LOBBYIST VISIT!
nay.subhead: Private ferry fares jump 40% overnight while Barker's campaign account swells mysteriously.

abstain.headline: BARKER ABSTAINS ON CLEAN WATER: 'I HAVE COMPLEX FEELINGS ABOUT BRIDGES'
abstain.subhead: Both commuters and ferry executives leave the gallery baffled.

bills.title: The Public Library Roof & Bookmobile Act
bills.summary: Repairs leaking county library roofs nationwide and funds traveling bookmobile vans for rural towns.

rider.text: Revenue Offset: Eliminates free public library cards and authorizes a $15-per-chapter 'Reading Convenience Tariff' paid to Private Collections Corp.

heckles.text: BACK MY BOOKMOBILE DEAL, KID! I'LL OWE YOU ONE IN WEEK 6!
Fifteen bucks a chapter?! Oh, this is front-page gold!
Check Subsection 19-C before you stamp, Barnaby!

aye.headline: CHAPTER TAX SHOCK! BARKER BACKS $15-PER-CHAPTER LIBRARY FEE!
aye.subhead: Rep. Troughman beams: 'Dry roofs aren't free, folks—and kids should learn fiscal realism early!'

nay.headline: BARKER KILLS LIBRARY FEE RIDER; TROUGHMAN THREATENS TO STALL ROOKIE'S BILLS!
nay.subhead: Head Librarian Penny Mallard applauds—even as Troughman tells reporters Barker 'hates dry books.'

abstain.headline: BARKER DUCKS LIBRARY VOTE, BLAMES OVERDUE PAPERWORK!
abstain.subhead: Neither the library board nor the Appropriations veteran takes it kindly.

bills.title: The Rural Telegraph & Post Office Modernization Act
bills.summary: Modernizes aging county post offices and expands high-speed municipal telegraph lines to outlying communities.

redactions.hidden: 60% of rural post offices and leases the buildings to K-Street Storage Holdings

redactions.prefix: Section 6: Replaces standard local mail with

heckles.text: Ignore the redaction ink—merely proprietary logistics phrasing.
A serious representative never votes on blacked-out clauses.

aye.headline: STAMPED OUT! BARKER APPROVES RURAL POST OFFICE CLOSURES & $35 MAIL FEE!
aye.subhead: Retired carrier Old Man Boarwell shakes his head as Maple Creek's post office gets padlocked.

nay.headline: INK-STAINED SLEUTH! BARKER SCRUBS REDACTIONS & SAVES LOCAL POST OFFICES!
nay.subhead: Chairwoman Kodiak delivers a rare, thunderous nod of respect from the Rules dais.

abstain.headline: BARKER REFUSES TO VOTE ON MAIL BILL: 'THE BLACK INK WAS TOO INTIMIDATING'
abstain.subhead: Chairwoman Kodiak sighs loudly enough to rattle the chandeliers.

bills.title: The 'Small Business Relief & Also 1,200 Other Pages' Omnibus
bills.summary: A massive three-part legislative package bundled overnight. Flip through every page before deciding your vote!

pages.heading: TITLE I — NEIGHBORHOOD SMALL BUSINESS RELIEF
pages.body: Provides zero-interest storm-repair loans to main-street bakeries, hardware shops, and family diners across every district.

pages.heading: TITLE II — FIRETRUCKS & WATER TOWERS
pages.body: Replaces aging volunteer fire engines and repaints municipal water towers before winter.

pages.heading: TITLE III (PAGE 1,204) — TECHNICAL ADJUSTMENTS
pages.body: WAIVES SAFETY INSPECTIONS for private toll highways, FREEZES PUBLIC SCHOOL REPAIR BUDGETS for 5 years, and TRIPLES Congressional Luncheon Allowances.

heckles.text: PASS THE OMNIBUS OR KISS YOUR COMMITTEE SEAT GOODBYE!
Don't bother with Page 3, kid—just look at those lovely firetrucks!
I'm waiting right outside the door with my flash bulb, Barker!

aye.headline: TRIPLE-LUNCH SCANDAL! BARKER RUBBER-STAMPS 1,204-PAGE MONSTER BILL!
aye.subhead: Shopkeepers get storm loans, schools freeze repairs, and Capitol catering bills triple overnight.

nay.headline: BARKER TANKS OMNIBUS! CRITICS BLAST 'NO' VOTE ON SMALL BUSINESS STORM AID!
nay.subhead: Whip Fang slams his binder while Mags Magpie sprints into the hallway for a live ambush quote.

abstain.headline: OMNIBUS FREEZE: BARKER HIDES BEHIND BINDER DURING MARATHON VOTE!
abstain.subhead: Neither small shops nor Caucus Leadership know what to make of it.

bills.title: Your Signature Legislation
bills.summary: This is why you ran for Congress. Call in banked Favor Tokens or rally Hometown Pressure to reach 3 votes, then slam CALL THE VOTE!

grassroots.title: The Maple Creek Community Center & Park Act
grassroots.summary: Restores District 9's leaking community hall, upgrades neighborhood playgrounds, and builds an all-weather town pavilion.

climber.title: The Regional Commuter Rail & Main Street Act
climber.summary: Connects rural stations to county transit hubs and revitalizes small-town storefront awnings along Highway 9.

pork_baron.title: The Grand District 9 Civic Plaza & Jobs Act
pork_baron.summary: Delivers $40M in federal construction contracts (and a suspiciously heroic brass fountain in your honor) to Maple Creek.

porkAttachments.label: Keep Your Bill 100% Clean
porkAttachments.description: Zero backroom additions. Voters love the purity, so you'll rely on banked Favors or Hometown Pressure (Constituents >= 68).

porkAttachments.label: Attach Troughman's Bridge Earmark (+1 Vote)
porkAttachments.description: Adds a $22M 'Troughman Expressway Ramp' to your bill. Guarantees Rep. Troughman's vote on the floor.

porkAttachments.label: Slip in Viper's Inspection Loophole (+1 Vote & +14 Cash)
porkAttachments.description: Buried footnote exempts Viper's developer clients from municipal safety checks. Buys a vote and pads your War Chest.

porkAttachments.label: Let Whip Fang Co-Brand the Bill (+1 Vote & +8 Party)
porkAttachments.description: Leadership slaps the Caucus crest across your cover page and whips an extra vote—at the cost of independent credibility.

heckles.text: Everyone back in Maple Creek is listening to the floor broadcast!
Hope you banked enough favors—or kept your hometown happy.

pass.headline: FRESHMAN TRIUMPH! BARKER'S FLAGSHIP BILL ROARS THROUGH THE HOUSE!
pass.subhead: Maple Creek erupts in cheers as the rookie pup proves he can actually move legislation.

fail.headline: DEFEAT ON THE FLOOR! BARKER'S SIGNATURE BILL DIES SHORT OF A MAJORITY!
fail.subhead: Empty vote tallies and bruised pride leave the freshman staring at a silent chamber.

bills.title: The Plain-English Clarity & Paperwork Reduction Act
bills.summary: QUESTION ON THE FLOOR: "Shall the House NOT decline to uphold the repeal of the exemption preventing non-disclosure of committee luxury travel receipts?"

rider.text: PLAIN-ENGLISH TRANSLATION: Four nested negatives! Voting AYE keeps luxury committee junkets SECRET. Voting NAY forces full public receipts!

heckles.text: Go ahead, Barnaby—untangle four negatives while my ad team rolls tape!
It's literally titled 'Clarity'—just stamp AYE!
Diagram the sentence, Representative. Read your staff memo.

aye.headline: DOUBLE-NEGATIVE DISASTER! BARKER VOTES TO HIDE LUXURY TRAVEL RECEIPTS!
aye.subhead: Foxworth airs a 30-second commercial mocking Barker for flunking Capitol grammar.

nay.headline: BARKER CRACKS TRIPLE-NEGATIVE TRAP; EXPOSES SECRET JUNKET BILL!
nay.subhead: High school civics teacher Dr. Oona Owl gives Barker an A+ while insiders scramble to hide hotel tabs.

abstain.headline: GRAMMAR PARALYSIS: BARKER ABSTAINS ON 'CLARITY ACT'
abstain.subhead: Foxworth chuckles: 'If he can't read one sentence, how can he represent District 9?'

bills.title: The Campaign Ethics & Donor Transparency Act
bills.summary: Promises sweeping accountability for campaign donations and strict enforcement of election-year fundraising rules.

redactions.hidden: National Committee Bundlers and Anonymous Consulting Shells
a $5,000 federal audit fee on neighborhood potluck fundraisers

heckles.text: Vote against 'Ethics' and watch my billboards go up by noon!
A remarkably thoughtful framework for incumbent stability.
A $5,000 fee on town potlucks?! That's rigged!

aye.headline: POTLUCK CRACKDOWN! BARKER TAXES COMMUNITY FUNDRAISERS WHILE SHIELDING SHELL FUNDS!
aye.subhead: Maple Creek bake-sale volunteers hit with federal paperwork as K-Street donors celebrate.

nay.headline: BARKER TORCHES FAKE 'ETHICS' BILL; FOXWORTH CRIES FOUL ON CABLE NEWS!
nay.subhead: District 9 cheers the potluck rescue while donor money dries up.

abstain.headline: BARKER ABSTAINS ON ETHICS BILL—FOXWORTH DUBS HIM 'THE VANISHING PUP'
abstain.subhead: Voters wonder why their rep suddenly needed an urgent hallway break.

bills.title: The Emergency Bridge & Committee Order Omnibus
bills.summary: Flood-repair funding for Highway 9 paired with Chairwoman Kodiak's 72-Hour Reading Rule—and a heavily inked Page 3.

pages.heading: TITLE I — EMERGENCY HIGHWAY 9 BRIDGE AID
pages.body: Releases immediate federal construction grants to repair three flood-damaged highway bridges serving District 9.

pages.heading: TITLE II — KODIAK'S 72-HOUR READING RULE
pages.body: Bans surprise 1,000-page midnight drops and guarantees every lawmaker three full days to read bills before voting.

pages.heading: TITLE III — PROCUREMENT ADDENDUM
pages.body: SCRUB THE REDACTION BELOW BEFORE YOU VOTE!

redactions.hidden: permanent no-bid procurement contracts to Troughman Construction & Viper Consulting with zero audit oversight

heckles.text: Inspect every page, Barker. My endorsement hangs on your backbone.
Skip Page 3—just pass the bridge money!
Either way you stamp, my prime-time attack ad is already edited!

aye.headline: NO-BID JACKPOT! BARKER PASSES BRIDGE AID—AND 75-YEAR UN-AUDITED CONTRACTS!
aye.subhead: Highway 9 gets concrete, K-Street pops champagne, and Chairwoman Kodiak snaps her oak pencil in half.

nay.headline: BARKER EXPOSES NO-BID RIDER; KODIAK PRAISES 'SPINE OF STEEL'!
nay.subhead: Demanding a clean standalone bridge bill wins Kodiak's heavyweight respect—and a hallway ambush from Mags Magpie.

abstain.headline: BARKER FREEZES ON BRIDGE OMNIBUS; NEITHER COMMUTERS NOR BEARS PLEASED!
abstain.subhead: Mags Magpie pops a fresh flash bulb outside the chamber doors.

bills.title: The Midnight Continuity & Public Services Resolution
bills.summary: Final midnight vote on Election Eve! Keeps public parks, mail delivery, and municipal grants running through Election Week.

rider.text: Section 88: Automatically renews every expired special-interest tax loophole for 20 years and strips freshman lawmakers of independent town-hall budgets.

heckles.text: POLLS OPEN AT SUNRISE! VOTE WITH THE CAUCUS OR SINK ALONE!
Don't let them gut our town-hall budgets at midnight, Barnaby!
HOLD THE PRESSES—THIS FINAL STAMP DECIDES ELECTION DAY!

aye.headline: MIDNIGHT LOOPHOLE BLITZ! BARKER SIGNS 20-YEAR TAX BREAK ON ELECTION EVE!
aye.subhead: Town-hall budgets vanish while Barker's final ad war chest explodes overnight.

nay.headline: MIDNIGHT STAND! BARKER BLOCKS 11:58 PM LOOPHOLE GRAB AS POLLS OPEN!
nay.subhead: Maple Creek erupts in applause while Whip Fang shreds Barker's caucus lanyard.

abstain.headline: LIGHTS OUT: BARKER ABSTAINS AT MIDNIGHT HOURS BEFORE POLLS OPEN!
abstain.subhead: Even the Capitol night-shift custodian looks mildly disappointed.
